name: Computer History Museum Teen Volunteer Intern Program
what_you_do: Teens in grades 9 to 12 go behind the scenes with the education team. They research tech history. They meet Silicon Valley professionals. They lead tours and activities.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12.
deadline_text: Applications are currently closed. Join the interest list to hear about the next round.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the CHM internships page to join the mailing list.
notes: CHM says it is not accepting Teen Program applications right now; the page gives no reopening date. Join the interest list to be told when it opens. Pay and length are not stated.
